name: Bitaps Payment
description: Bitcoin (BTC) cryptocurrency payment method for the contrib Basket commerce module, using the Bitaps payment-address gateway.
project_description:
This module provides a Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) payment method to embed the payment services provided by https://www.bitaps.com/ .

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) 
 
 Back to top 

 Setup 
 
 After installation, go to the payment systems settings page /admin/basket/settings-payment . 
 Create a payment point and indicate in the service "Bitaps payment". 
 After you create, you will have a button to go to the settings page of the payment gateway itself. Or you can follow the link /admin/config/development/bitaps . 
 The module can also work in test mode.
